questions.stem: What is the difference between genotype and phenotype?

options.text: Genotype is the combination of alleles; phenotype is the observable characteristic
Genotype is the physical appearance; phenotype is the genetic makeup
Genotype refers to dominant alleles only; phenotype refers to recessive alleles

questions.explanation: The genotype is the combination of alleles an organism has (e.g., Bb), while the phenotype is the physical characteristic that is expressed (e.g., brown eyes).
